# study-planner-mcp

> Exam study schedules, spaced repetition dates, pomodoro plans and assignment milestones for AI. Works offline. Free and open source MCP server for AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot and others).

## Setup
- Run with npx -y study-planner-mcp
- No environment variables, no network and no account.
- Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. If start_date is left out it uses today's date.

## Tools
- make_study_plan
- spaced_repetition_dates
- pomodoro_plan
- assignment_milestones

## Links
- Source and README, https://github.com/AnonymousOnyx22/study-planner-mcp
